Reference load regulation and thermal self-heating

UV.raw_VIN_equation: VIN = VP + SS14 forward drop; actual drop is not established

limitations: Evaluated minimum is not a physical lower timing guarantee: DC bias and aging can reduce C further
Uses assumed 100 ppm/C resistor bounds; actual procurement data must agree
10 uA FET leakage is a conservative 125C allowance; board target ends at85C
Capacitor leakage/PCB contamination and extra negative current are not separately bounded
Relay release budget must be measured with the installed suppression circuit

reset_recovery_example.condition: Either C_HIGH or B_HARD clears, turning the timer reset FET on
reset_recovery_example.status: Illustrative first-order model with assumed FET on-resistance, not a guaranteed or measured recovery time

logic.implementation: U8 gate2 NAND(FAULT_OK, POR_N), followed by gate3 inverter
logic.qualification: Combinational model excludes propagation delays, analogue gate levels and the mechanical relay; the retained output/relay budget requires physical verification.

power_supervision.behavior: LOW POR_N inhibits permit. HIGH POR_N permits immediately when all comparator conditions are healthy; no onboard reset or stored trip is used.
power_supervision.external_relay_retention: User-confirmed relay-board latch retains a shutdown after its relay has opened.
